tool.name: Filter out rows

param.name: min
param.label: The minimum value to keep. Ignored if None (None by default).
param.help: The minimum value to keep. Ignored if None (None by default).

param.name: max
param.label: The maximum value to keep. Ignored if None (None by default).
param.help: The maximum value to keep. Ignored if None (None by default).

param.name: numbers_to_remove
param.label: Comma separated numbers to filter out (for example "0,1,55").
param.help: Comma separated numbers to filter out (for example "0,1,55").

param.name: strings_to_remove
param.label: Comma separated string to filter out (for example "the,words,to,remove").
param.help: Comma separated string to filter out (for example "the,words,to,remove").

param.name: input_dataframe
param.label: Input DataFrame (CSV)
param.help: Optional CSV file containing input DataFrame for batch processing

tool.help: Filter out rows containing given values and from given range.
